protocol_type: Queue-pair (SQ/CQ) command-completion protocol layered on PCI Express. Host fills a 64-byte SQE, rings the SQ Tail Doorbell; controller fetches via PCIe MRd, executes, writes back a 16-byte CQE, signals MSI-X interrupt; host rings the CQ Head Doorbell.

channels.name: TXp/TXn
channels.description: Differential transmit pair. AC-coupled, 8b/10b-encoded, 2.5 Gb/s per Lane at Gen 1.

channels.name: RXp/RXn
channels.description: Differential receive pair, symmetric counterpart of TXp/TXn.

channels.name: REFCLK+/REFCLK-
channels.description: 100 MHz reference; spread-spectrum-clocking (SSC) tolerant. May be shared (Common Clock) or independent (Separate Clock).

channels.name: PERST#
channels.description: Fundamental Reset. Active LOW. Asserted while main power is unstable; deasserted to start link training.

channels.name: WAKE#
channels.description: Open-drain WAKE signal. Pulled LOW by any device that wants to resume from L2 / L3.

packet_classes.purpose: Carries Memory / I/O / Configuration / Message transactions end-to-end across the fabric.
Link management only; never propagated past the Link.
subtypes: PM (Power Management — PM_Enter_L1 / PM_Enter_L23 / PM_Active_State_Request_L1 / PM_Request_Ack)

common_first_DW_fields: Length[9:0] (DW count of data payload, max 1024 DW = 4 KB)
tlp_header_format.memory_request_addressing: Bit 29 of the Type/Fmt encoding distinguishes 32-bit (3 DW header) from 64-bit (4 DW header) addressing for Memory Requests.
tlp_header_format.completion_header: Always 3 DW header; includes Completer ID (Bus/Device/Function), Completion Status, Byte Count, Requester ID, Tag, Lower Address.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: Flow control is credit-based per Virtual Channel — transmitter must have sufficient credits (6 credit types: PH, PD, NPH, NPD, CplH, CplD) before sending a TLP.
Data Link Layer guarantees TLP delivery via ACK/NAK + replay: receiver sends Ack DLLP (sequence number n) on successful LCRC; transmitter retires TLPs with sequence ≤ n from the Retry Buffer.
On LCRC or framing error, receiver sends Nak DLLP (last good sequence number); transmitter replays all TLPs after that sequence from the Retry Buffer.
REPLAY_TIMER and ACK_TIMER bound the worst-case wait before forcing replay; REPLAY_NUM rollover declares Link failure → LTSSM Recovery.
Update Flow Control (UpdateFC) DLLPs are emitted periodically by the receiver to advertise running credits as buffer space is freed.

addressing.configuration_address_format: Bus(8) + Device(5) + Function(3) + Extended Register Number(4) + Register Number(6) — selects within 4 KB extended Config Space

frame_format.completion_queue_entry: 16 bytes per Figure 121 (DW0 cmd-specific + DW1 reserved + DW2 SQID:SQHD + DW3 SF:P:CID).
frame_format.prp_entry: 64-bit Page Base Address + Offset; offset width = log2(MPS).
frame_format.sgl_descriptor: 16 bytes; type-specific (Data Block / Bit Bucket / Segment / Last Segment / Keyed / Transport).

common_dword_0_fields.name: Command Identifier (CID)
common_dword_0_fields.description: Unique per-SQ identifier; combined with SQID uniquely identifies an outstanding command.

common_dword_0_fields.name: PRP or SGL for Data Transfer (PSDT)
Opcode (OPC)
common_dword_0_fields.description: Command opcode (Admin or I/O OPC space).

layout.name: SQ Head Pointer (SQHD)
layout.description: Current SQ Head Pointer; controller's mechanism to advance host-visible SQ head.

layout.name: Phase Tag (P)
layout.description: Inverted each pass through CQ ring.

status_field_structure.M_bit: 30  — More; additional info in Error Information log.
status_field_structure.SCT: 27:25 — Status Code Type: 0h Generic, 1h Cmd Specific, 2h Media/Data, 3h Path, 7h Vendor.

fused_operations.description: Two adjacent SQEs fused into a single atomic operation; first has FUSE=01b, second has FUSE=10b.
fused_operations.canonical_example: Compare (0x05) followed by Write (0x01) — Compare-and-Write atomic semantics.

queue_doorbell_protocol.host_submits_command: Host fills next free SQ slot; writes SQyTDBL = new Tail.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_fetches: Controller issues PCIe MRd TLP targeting SQE; reads 64 bytes.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_completes: Controller issues PCIe MWr TLP posting 16-byte CQE; inverts Phase Tag on ring wrap.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_signals: Controller asserts the configured interrupt (MSI-X vector per Create I/O CQ.IV).
queue_doorbell_protocol.host_processes: Host polls CQE Phase Tag, processes, writes CQyHDBL = new Head.
